# Held seeded EH linker-read diagnostic design

Scope: one controlled-image `libnoexit.a` condition. This branch does not register a runnable workflow or claim linker consumption. It preserves the PR143 producer, PR149 linker preflight, PR150 FD fixture parser, and PR138 output custody as separate evidence.

## Immutable joins and first refusal

The producer is PR143 run `40536996581` attempt 1, head `7c8a9cbad78e1fbcdfedb301b8e579c98dbec7d8`, artifact `12748008032`, ZIP SHA-256 `0f051bf7adec09d86d786e5642c4ef89018da6958ab04094264c52ae8bd7ab57`. The held seed helper itself invokes PR149's `authenticate` on the pinned API metadata and ZIP, requiring a fresh `/work/image/pr143-auth` extraction directory and fresh auth receipt. It then constructs `/work/image/pr143-auth/image-libnoexit.a` internally; callers cannot pass a source archive path. The six-member exact-name/size/hash/CRC/receipt checks establish the image member name separately from the byte-equal clean member. A caller must initialize an outer refusal receipt before starting remote work with `linker_archive_read=UNPROVEN`, `same_run_eh_outputs=UNPROVEN`, and legal/product/fleet admission `NO`.

The pinned image is `emscripten/emsdk:3.1.48@sha256:c952f592577a428698cb990c9656f395ae34424740f9c40bed4c3ee6d4850d29`. PR149's hosted linker preflight run `40549577194` observed `/emsdk/upstream/bin/wasm-ld` resolve to `/emsdk/upstream/bin/lld`, ELF SHA-256 `6e5c12aab29b80db118acd16c08953257683ed11c415970f8320ed777997eec7`; repeat that preflight in this same run. A successful `--version` exec alone is not the EH child witness.

## Required hosted sequence before dispatch

1. Replay PR138's pinned source `0bb7c5237dc1b047de488d67ba30b5ed05c37383`, custody `1d77df7776dca44731ae8267092e480a78f9f735`, DuckDB Wasm `f955138e5218942fb3fb097a8fdcb725222406ff`, and submodules `401c8061c6ece35949cac58c7770cc755710ca86` / `ca1c30f60d6419849dbc2a533bd0bcaff310185f`. Verify the two PR138 source patches, custody manifest and five assets by digest before configuring. The PR138 build uses a zero-byte JSON extension sentinel, no Excel sentinel, no loadable extensions, `WITH_WASM_EXCEPTIONS=1`, `DUCKDB_CUSTOM_PLATFORM=wasm_eh`, and `-Wl,-Map,<one fresh map>`.
2. Start with absent `/work/image/cache` inside the pinned container. Independently query the pinned Emscripten cache/settings API for the selected `libnoexit.a` path under the actual `EM_CACHE`; require exactly `/work/image/cache/sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten/libnoexit.a`. The held seed helper checks absent/empty cache, regular non-symlink ancestors, exact image member name and digest, a unique archive, then records device/inode/size/mode/hash. Re-run its `verify` immediately before and after the traced link. It does **not** itself prove that the path was settings-derived; that independent query is still required.
3. Permit Emscripten to create the other SDK archives. Refuse if it creates or replaces a second `libnoexit.a`, alters the seeded inode or bytes, or changes `EM_CACHE`. Generate and hash the exact `CMakeFiles/duckdb_wasm.dir/link.txt`, `objects1.rsp`, and `linklibs.rsp`. Require one map token and the selected archive path in the response; reject a command that points at an old cache or output. A first link may produce same-run map/JS/Wasm baseline, but remove all three live outputs before replay. This seeded cache is a new condition; its hashes must never be compared as a purported image/clean PR138 pair.
4. Reauthenticate PR138's pinned strace 5.16 private loader and runtime dependency bytes, ELF/SONAME/symbol versions, selected notices, then execute a same-run child-ptrace canary. Use a finite 600-second trace with `-f -ff -yy -s 4096 -v` and at least `execve,execveat,fork,vfork,clone,open,openat,openat2,chdir,fchdir,dup,dup2,dup3,fcntl,close,close_range,read,pread64,readv,mmap,munmap,exit,exit_group`. The PR150 parser's fixture success is insufficient until it accepts the actual complete hosted trace shape. An unbounded/polled-only raw trace size is still a blocker for an acceptance run.
5. Parse every PID trace, establish the successfully execed exact pinned linker PID, and require that PID's direct successful read-only open of the canonical seed path and positive-byte `read`, `pread64`, or `readv` on that live FD. Reject parent/child/inherited-FD reads, stale/reused FD, unresolved path, split/truncated trace, and mmap-only. Cross-check FD path against pre/post device/inode and archive hash; `-yy` annotation is corroboration only. Require successful tracee exit. Delete raw traces in all outcomes.
6. Require freshly created nonempty map/JS/Wasm, hash them and the link/response files, and join one map selection of `libnoexit.a(atexit_dummy.o):(__cxa_atexit)` to the seeded archive's sole physical member/ordinal and exact object hash `d58194aea8fda6a000d2aa479617837afc6a7d527dcc670060bd7faade9d2ea1`. Bound the sanitized receipt to 2 MiB and preserve the 400 MiB EH custody budget. Only then may a peer-reviewed hosted audit consider `CONTROLLED_LIBNOEXIT_DIRECT_LINKER_READ_PROVED` for this one archive. The other eight SDK archive keys and full legal/product/fleet admission remain open.

## Current stop point

The seed helper establishes authenticated image-member identity and refuses archive replacement at its `verify` calls. Its direct clean-member selection refusal was exercised locally. A new `workflow_call` source unit now checks out the exact PR138 source/custody/upstream heads, applies pinned patches, derives the archive path with a disposable shadow cache before seeding, rechecks the actual setting after configure and build, builds EH once, hashes fresh map/JS/Wasm and response files, and retains only a bounded receipt or fixed refusal. This source is unreviewed and undispatched; no hosted build result exists yet. There is no private tracer runtime staging/canary, hard bounded trace sink, traced link invocation, actual-hosted trace parser acceptance, or fresh traced-output/member join. Consequently it must not be described as an EH linker-read proof or used for legal/product/fleet admission.
